answer:
- NVIDIA’s FY2026 revenue rose 65% to $215.9 billion for the year ended January 25, 2026. The main driver was demand for Data Center compute and networking platforms supporting accelerated computing and AI. Blackwell architectures accounted for the majority of Data Center revenue. [S8] [S11] [S12]
- Data Center revenue grew 68%. Within that business, compute revenue increased 59%, driven by Blackwell demand; networking revenue increased 142%, driven by the NVLink compute fabric ramp for GB200 and GB300 systems and growth in Ethernet and InfiniBand platforms. [S7] [S8] [S12]
- Other businesses also contributed: Gaming revenue grew 41% on strong Blackwell demand; Professional Visualization grew 70% on Blackwell demand and the DGX Spark launch; Automotive grew 39% through continued adoption of NVIDIA’s self-driving platforms. [S12]
